Another important factor is your free time after school. The model indicates that you have low free time, which can limit your ability to study or engage in activities that reinforce learning. Many students who pass tend to have more balanced schedules, allowing them to dedicate time to their studies.

Lastly, the reason you chose this school, based on its reputation, is a positive influence. However, it is not strong enough to outweigh the concerns raised by your past failures and limited free time. 

To improve your academic performance, consider increasing your study time and seeking additional support, such as tutoring or study groups. Engaging more actively with your studies and managing your time effectively can help you build a stronger foundation for success. Additionally, addressing any health issues you may be facing could also enhance your overall well-being and academic performance.
